exposure: Temporary bilateral uterine artery occlusion combined with laparoscopy and hysteroscopy
cohort: This study included 126 women who had one or more cesarean deliveries with abnormal uterine bleeding (12-20 days).
finding: The study found that combining laparoscopy, hysteroscopy, temporary bilateral uterine artery occlusion, and vasopressin injection effectively reduced blood loss and improved menstrual cycles in women with cesarean scar defects.
